Answered Fabio's 'I don't know what SeedVR needs' against /object_info on :48188 rather than guessing: SeedVR2Conditioning takes model + a VAE LATENT and emits both positive and negative conditioning, so there is no prompt and no denoise, and the weight set has no text encoder to give it one. chunking_mode 'auto' sizes chunks to free VRAM, so frames_per_chunk stays unexposed. A SeedVR2 entry therefore declares ZERO extra controls, which pairs with PiD's prompt+denoise to make the per-entry control list a real mechanism instead of a special case.

Answered Fabio's three questions off the shipped ComfyUI templates and the live engine rather than guessing. Precision corrected to int8_convrot (his call, and what every official template uses - fp8 is Ada+ only, int8 also runs on Ampere and Vision still ships to 30-series). SeedVR2 confirmed to do IMAGES as well as video via two official image templates, so its entries go in both dropdowns; there is no 7B video template, so bench that. Reference graph captured from the templates. And the 1K/2K/3K/4K relabel turns out to be native - core ResizeImageMaskNode has a 'scale longer dimension' mode taking an absolute longer_size, which retires the 'four buttons, two meanings' warning.

Fabio corrected the resolution framing: SeedVR2 is natively a multiplier (the templates ship 'scale by multiplier'), only PiD is absolute, and an earlier note here implied otherwise. Kept one hard finding on the absolute side: the multiplier input caps at 8.0, so a sub-512px source cannot reach a 4K label - 'scale longer dimension' has no such ceiling. Choice, not a requirement.

Recorded the asymmetry so the four-file PiD decision does not get copied here: SeedVR2's three variants differ in one injectable literal and share a VAE, so two files (one per tool) cover it rather than six.

First real SeedVR2 run came out degraded and the log named the cause: auto chose frames_per_chunk=5 for 81 frames at 3.31Mpx on a 16GB card, and the template ships temporal_overlap=0 = plain concatenation. Reproduced the sizing formula exactly against the log. The fix needs no MpiNode and no loop pack - temporal_overlap is clamped to what the chunk allows, so a constant 8 self-adapts everywhere. Two structural facts recorded: chunking cannot be avoided at any useful resolution on this card, and the result is dominated by the user's GPU via a flat 10.7GiB reserve. Corrects this card's earlier 'auto solves VRAM with no UI'.

summary: Brief 2d rewritten, 2e and 2f added. Measured three SeedVR2 defects on the bench: temporal_overlap 8 clamps to force step 1 and ghosts the image, auto chunking is ~5x too conservative (allowed 3 latents where 15 run), color_correction none leaves luma drift. Ship overlap 2, manual chunking, lab. Chunk ceiling still needs a lowvram re-measure on 48188.

Fabio picked frames_per_chunk 57 after reviewing the bench clips - best looking and fastest at 268s. Laplacian variance had ranked 33 higher and was wrong; it counts grain as detail, so it detects a within-clip collapse but cannot rank two healthy runs.

Image path measured and BOTH paths now carry all three variants (brief 2g + 2h). Image: no VRAM problem at all - no chunker exists there, so every variant ran at every multiplier including 7B at 4x (13.17 Mpx, 63s, no OOM). Colour correction lab cuts worst-case drift 84 percent for a 2 percent sharpness cost, same ranking as the video sweep. Video: fpc 57 OOMs on 7B; 37 runs clean on both 7B and 7B Sharp, and the drop was predicted from the weight delta before it was measured, so frames_per_chunk must be a function of the SELECTED VARIANT, not just free VRAM. A 3B control at the same fpc 37 removed the confound: chunk size costs 12 percent, the model gap is 1.9x, so 3B stays the video default and 7B costs 45 percent more wall clock to do less at 1.5x. Same inversion on both paths - 7B is conservative at small multipliers and only leads at 4x. Three graph defects found and fixed in bench copies: two VHS_VideoCombine nodes were executing as real outputs, an orphan VAEDecode, and frames_per_chunk was a bare widget the app could never inject. Both bench graphs now convert against 48188 and pass validate-injection-rules; the repo runtime files still need Fabio to Export them to comfy_workflows/raw/ because raw is user-owned.
